# t_flex

t_flex

## Usage

``` r
t_flex(mymatrix)
```

## Arguments

- mymatrix:

  matrix to use

## Value

matrix

## Examples

``` r
m <- matrix(rnorm(100), nrow = 10)

t_flex(m)
```
